newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon signs $102 mln port deal with Spanish firm.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon signs $102 mln port deal with Spanish firm.

text.p: The port of Beirut signed a contract with Entracanales y Tavora of Spain a $102.8 million to renovate the war-damaged facility, port chairman Antoine Rayes said on Tuesday.
He said that work on the three-year renovation will start after six months.

"We signed the agreement with the Entracanales y Tavora this afternoon, and work will start after six months during which they will study the positions, and they are expected to finish within three years," Rayes told Reuters.

The deal includes building a container station, two 280-metres (yards) long quays, adding the breakwater and paving and asphalting roads and open areas totalling 700,000 square metres. Water, electricity and telephone networks will also upgraded.
